purpose: Acknowledge one factor while giving special weight to another.
keywords: N + もさることながら + N + も
The taste is excellent, and the aroma is remarkable too.
Skill matters, but perseverance is especially necessary.
The contents are appealing, and so is the cover.
formation: N + もさることながら + N + も
restrictions: The second factor usually receives the main emphasis.
mistake: It does not dismiss the importance of the first factor.
